prompts.title: 超逼真的冬季街头摄影
prompts.description: 一个针对 Gemini Nano Banana 2 的高度详细提示，指示其生成一张超现实的冬季街头男士写真图像。该提示强调严格保留上传照片中的面部，精确的姿势和服装细节（u2k 风格），固定的拍摄角度（iPhone 胸部水平），密集的背景元素（湿沥青、汽车、商店橱窗），以及特定的光照条件（冬日傍晚的冷暖混合光），以捕捉 2000 年代风格的“定格瞬间”。
prompts.content: Shot on iPhone, winter street photoshoot, ultra-realism, natural shot: SAVE FACE FROM UPLOADED PHOTO 1:1 — do not change features, proportions, age, facial expressions and similarity even by 1%, use the uploaded photo as the ONLY face standard), plot: a man in the center of a busy winter city street makes a "reporter's" street shot, holds a compact camera/camcorder to his face, as if he is filming in response, the pose is fixed, stance U2K confident, pelvis slightly shifted to the right, shoulders relaxed, one hand holds a compact camera to the lips/chin, the other hand deep in the pocket, elbow slightly pulled back, looking straight into the lens, expression calm and bold; the angle is fixed: shooting on an iPhone from chest level, slight wide-angle (26mm feel), the hero is strictly in the center, the frame is waist-deep, the perspective is minimal, without a "corridor" into the distance, the background is dense and close; the background is strictly defined: a winter evening in the city, wet asphalt and slush, behind the hero there is a wide street with closely parked cars in two rows, on the right next to (3-5 meters) a parked dark minivan, on the left the facade of a building with brightly lit shop-windows and an entrance, above the entrance there are 2-3 small neon signs without legible words, on the sidewalk around the hero there are 10-15 people in winter clothes (some are passing by, some are standing in a group near the shop-window), all the faces of passers-by are slightly blurred so that the focus remains on the model; a street lamp, road signs, reflections of lights in the wet asphalt are visible in the frame, no long horizon, a "wall" of buildings and cars in the background, short depth; The clothes are strictly defined (u2k unisex, winter): a short glossy down jacket "metallic silver" made of nylon with a high collar, under it a white tight-fitting thermal jacket without prints, bottoms: low-rise dark gray baggy jeans with a belt, shoes: winter sneakers/boots white and gray with a massive sole, accessories: narrow rectangular glasses u2k with dark lenses, black gloves, a small black shoulder-bag with a short strap over the shoulder, in hand a black compact camera/camcorder without logos; fixed light; winter evening mixed cold street + warm shop-window light, soft contrast, no flash, no studio light, natural shadows under the nose and chin, glare from the wet road; atmosphere: lively urban winter street, city noise, people moving, the feeling of a "captured moment" in the style of the 2000s; textures: hyper-realistic skin texture, natural pores and fine details, Subtle imperfections, slight reddening of cheeks from the cold, realistic lip gloss, detailed texture of the glossy nylon down jacket, visible seams and zipper, denim with a pronounced weave and creases, wet asphalt with reflections, grainy slush, camera plastic with small scratches; camera and processing: iPhone photo look, iPhone RAW, slight dig
prompts.translatedContent: 用 iPhone 拍摄，冬季街头摄影，超现实主义，自然抓拍：从上传的照片中保存面部 1:1 — 不要改变特征、比例、年龄、面部表情和相似度，即使是 1% 也不行，将上传的照片作为唯一的面部标准），情节：一个男人在繁忙的冬季城市街道中央进行“记者式”街拍，将一台小型相机/摄像机举到脸前，仿佛正在回应拍摄，姿势固定，站姿自信，骨盆略微向右倾斜，肩膀放松，一只手将小型相机举到嘴唇/下巴处，另一只手插在口袋深处，手肘略微向后收，直视镜头，表情平静而大胆；角度固定：用 iPhone 从胸部高度拍摄，略带广角（26mm 视角），主人公严格居中，画面到腰部，透视感极小，没有“走廊”般的远景，背景密集而近；背景严格限定：城市冬日傍晚，湿漉漉的柏油路和泥泞，主人公身后是一条宽阔的街道，两排汽车紧密停放，右侧（3-5 米处）停着一辆深色小型货车，左侧是一栋建筑的立面，橱窗灯火通明，入口上方有 2-3 个没有清晰文字的小霓虹灯牌，人行道上主人公周围有 10-15 个穿着冬装的人（一些人路过，一些人成群站在橱窗旁），所有路人的脸部都略微模糊，以便焦点保持在模特身上；画面中可见路灯、路标、湿柏油路上的灯光倒影，没有长长的地平线，背景是建筑物和汽车组成的“墙”，景深短；服装严格限定（中性，冬季）：一件短款亮面“金属银”尼龙羽绒服，高领，内搭一件白色紧身无印花保暖内衣，下装：低腰深灰色宽松牛仔裤配腰带，鞋子：冬季运动鞋/靴子，白色和灰色，厚底，配饰：窄长方形深色镜片眼镜，黑色手套，一个短肩带黑色小斜挎包，手中拿着一台无标志的黑色小型相机/摄像机；光线固定：冬日傍晚，混合了寒冷的街灯和温暖的橱窗灯光，柔和对比，无闪光灯，无影室灯，鼻子和下巴下方有自然阴影，湿漉漉的路上有眩光；氛围：热闹的城市冬季街道，城市喧嚣，人来人往，2000 年代风格的“抓拍瞬间”感；纹理：超逼真的皮肤纹理，自然的毛孔和细微细节，细微的瑕疵，脸颊因寒冷而略微泛红，逼真的唇彩，亮面尼龙羽绒服的细节纹理，可见的接缝和拉链，有明显编织和褶皱的牛仔布，有倒影的湿柏油路，颗粒状的泥泞，有小划痕的相机塑料；相机和后期：iPhone 摄影效果，iPhone RAW，轻微数码感。

prompts.title: 奢华护肤品商业视频提示
prompts.description: 一个为视频生成（Kling 3.0 + Nano Banana Pro）设计的详细提示，用于创建一支奢华护肤品广告。它明确了美学风格、产品摆放、灯光、摄像机运动（缓慢的 360 度环绕）和整体氛围，并要求使用提供的产品图片作为造型和细节的参考。
prompts.content:
Luxury skincare commercial, ultra-premium aesthetic. Use the provided product image as the exact reference for bottle shape, label design, liquid tone, reflections, and overall styling.

The bottle stands perfectly upright at the center of the frame, surrounded by a glossy liquid surface with smooth, elegant ripples. Soft fluid splashes form a graceful crown around the base, catching light like crystal. Background is a dreamy pastel aqua-to-soft lavender gradient with a silky, creamy atmosphere and subtle mist particles floating in the air.

Camera motion:
Slow, continuous 360-degree cinematic orbit around the product. Movement is smooth, controlled, and hypnotic. Constant speed throughout. No shaking, no zooming, no speed changes. The product remains perfectly centered and stable at all times.

Framing:
Mid close-up beauty shot. Bottle remains vertical and motionless, hero focus.

Lighting:
High-end studio lighting, soft diffused glow with gentle highlights and glossy reflections. Subtle rim light to outline the bottle. Liquid and glass look luminous, hydrated, and silky.

Mood & style:
Sensual, elegant, and premium beauty campaign. Smooth motion, glossy textures, soft reflections, cinematic depth of field, slow-motion feel, luxury skincare advertisement, 4K photorealistic, polished commercial look.
prompts.translatedContent:
奢华护肤品广告，极致高端美学。请以提供的产品图片为精确参考，包括瓶身形状、标签设计、液体色调、反光效果和整体造型。

瓶身完美地垂直立于画面中央，周围环绕着光泽的液面，泛起柔和优雅的涟漪。柔和的液体飞溅在瓶身底部形成一个优美的“皇冠”，如水晶般捕捉着光线。背景是梦幻般的柔和水绿色到淡薰衣草色的渐变，营造出丝滑、奶油般的氛围，空气中漂浮着细微的雾气颗粒。

镜头运动：
围绕产品进行缓慢、连续的 360 度电影式环绕拍摄。运动流畅、受控且富有催眠感。全程保持恒定速度。无抖动、无变焦、无速度变化。产品始终保持完美居中和稳定。

构图：
中景特写美妆镜头。瓶身保持垂直静止，作为核心焦点。

灯光：
高端影棚布光，柔和漫射光，带有轻微的高光和光泽反射。细微的轮廓光勾勒出瓶身。液体和玻璃看起来晶莹剔透、水润丝滑。

氛围与风格：

prompts.content:
Use the uploaded picture as a reference (Strict identity lock, the face must match the attached reference photo exactly, preserving facial structure, skin tone, expression, and hairstyle (same haircut and hair texture) to create an ultra-realistic cinematic double exposure portrait of me in a clean left-facing side profile, sharp jawline and natural facial structure clearly defined.
The outer silhouette is dark and well-contoured against a soft warm beige sunset background. Inside the silhouette, seamlessly blend a dramatic urban street scene at golden hour: a lone me walking forward in the center of an empty destroyed city road, symmetrical perspective lines, damaged buildings on both sides, broken debris scattered along sidewalks, electric poles and cables stretching into the distance.
The sun positioned directly at the horizon behind the walking figure, creating strong backlight glow and long stretched shadow toward the camera.
Warm orange sunlight flooding through the internal city scene, high contrast, cinematic depth, realistic textures, smooth blending edges between portrait and environment.
Moody yet hopeful atmosphere, 8K resolution, sharp detail, soft vignette. size 4 5 image generate.
